keys.name: FIXED_LEDGE_READ
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body reads a moving platform far below/right while both feet own the fixed ledge.

keys.name: REAR_HEEL_LOAD
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root sinks rearward as the platform advances and rises; asymmetry commits the eventual long diagonal flight.

keys.name: SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear leg spends fixed support and launches the root up-right; the platform remains an external moving support candidate, not magical air support.

keys.name: LONG_DIAGONAL_FLIGHT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Unsupported root travels strongly up-right while the platform rises beneath a different worldline.

keys.name: APEX_OPEN
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Wide apex silhouette; limbs open while the platform continues rising independently.

keys.name: DESCENT_AIM
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root descends; right foot points toward the approaching deck while free-side arm trails to preserve asymmetry.

keys.name: UNDERCATCH_PRECONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Right toe is one row above the rising deck; the body remains unsupported and the deck continues upward toward the toe.

keys.name: LEAD_TOE_UNDERCATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: The rising deck reaches the right toe from below. Support is acquired exactly here while relative closing velocity remains nonzero.

keys.name: RELATIVE_VELOCITY_CRUSH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Deck continues rising while the root descends one row; root-to-deck gap collapses into a deep one-foot crush and the free leg whips clear.

keys.name: PLATFORM_CARRY_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Support frame carries the root up-right; torso and free-side limb lag back-left, paying the undercatch impulse with visible overshoot.

keys.name: TRAIL_HEEL_SHEAR_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Delayed trailing heel catches after the one-foot carry, creating a wide sheared base instead of instant symmetric dual support.

keys.name: LOADED_RISE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Both feet remain on the moving deck but the left leg drives a loaded rise; right-side hand lags behind the torso.

keys.name: PLATFORM_BRAKE_BODY_LAG
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Platform vertical rise brakes to zero while foot topology stays dual; torso and hands overrun the support frame, proving topology is not load.

keys.name: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Body settles downward relative to the now vertically stopped platform at a new high/right address; no reverse interpolation or ledge-idle reset.
